name: Epoetin alfa
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Epoetin alfa is an erythropoiesis-stimulating agent (ESA) for anemia of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Its dose is set by hemoglobin response, not by kidney function. The US label starts treatment when hemoglobin is below 10 g/dL and warns that targeting hemoglobin above 11 g/dL raises the risk of death, cardiovascular events and stroke.
kidney_function_basis: Dosing is by hemoglobin, not eGFR; the label separates CKD on dialysis from CKD not on dialysis.

bands.recommendation: Kidney-function dosing does not apply; CKD-anemia rules as for CKD not on dialysis when indicated.

CKD not on dialysis: consider starting only if hemoglobin <10 g/dL and transfusion risk reduction is a goal; start 50 to 100 Units/kg 3 times weekly intravenously (IV) or subcutaneously (SC); reduce or interrupt if hemoglobin exceeds 10 g/dL (label).

hd.text: Start when hemoglobin <10 g/dL; 50 to 100 Units/kg 3 times weekly, IV route recommended for hemodialysis; reduce or interrupt if hemoglobin approaches or exceeds 11 g/dL (label).

pd.text: CKD on dialysis rules (start when hemoglobin <10 g/dL; 50 to 100 Units/kg 3 times weekly IV or SC; reduce or interrupt near 11 g/dL) (label).

dialyzable: Half-life in adults with serum creatinine >3 mg/dL is similar on and off dialysis (label).
monitoring: Hemoglobin at least weekly after starting or changing dose until stable, then at least monthly; do not increase more often than every 4 weeks; reduce by 25% or more if hemoglobin rises >1 g/dL in 2 weeks; iron status; blood pressure (label).

pediatric.approved_ages: Anemia due to CKD: pediatric patients 1 month and older (label).
pediatric.usual_dose: CKD: start only when hemoglobin <10 g/dL; 50 Units/kg 3 times weekly IV or SC; reduce or interrupt if hemoglobin approaches or exceeds 12 g/dL (label).
pediatric.max_dose: No absolute cap in the label for pediatric CKD; titrate to the lowest dose that avoids transfusion.

renal.recommendation: Dosing is by hemoglobin, not eGFR: 50 Units/kg 3 times weekly when hemoglobin <10 g/dL (label).

pediatric.neonates: Neonates and infants: use the single-dose (benzyl alcohol-free) vial; multiple-dose vials are contraindicated (label). Dose: specialist input.
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

adult: Kidney panel bands are not really meaningful for an ESA; consider replacing the eGFR bands with 'CKD not on dialysis / on dialysis' rows.
Label is EPOGEN (BLA103234). PH has several epoetin alfa biosimilar/brand products; label wording may differ.
pediatric: Pediatric threshold to reduce dose is 12 g/dL (adults 11 g/dL on dialysis, 10 g/dL not on dialysis). Kept verbatim.
